name: Chicken & Rice Bowl
instructions: Rinse the rice, then cook it in a rice cooker or covered pot per package directions.
Pat the chicken breast dry, season with salt and pepper, and cut into even pieces for faster, more even cooking.
Heat half the olive oil in a pan over medium-high heat and cook the chicken 5-7 minutes per side until it hits 165F internally, then rest and slice.
Cut the broccoli into florets, toss with the remaining oil, and steam or roast until just tender, 8-10 minutes.
Divide the rice into 4 containers, top each with sliced chicken and broccoli.
Cool to room temperature before sealing, then refrigerate; reheat portions through before eating.
notes: Batch-cook staple, splits into 4 servings across the week.

name: Peanut Butter Banana Overnight Oats
instructions: Split the rolled oats evenly between 4 jars or containers.
Slice the bananas and divide them between the containers.
Add a spoonful of peanut butter to each, then top with enough water or milk to cover the oats (roughly 1:1 with the oats by volume).
Stir each jar, seal, and refrigerate overnight (at least 4 hours).
Stir again before eating; add a splash more liquid if it's thicker than you like.
notes: No active cook time, portion into jars the night before.

name: Egg & Cheese Scramble with Spinach
instructions: Crack the eggs into a bowl, season with salt and pepper, and whisk until uniform.
Heat the olive oil in a nonstick pan over medium heat and add the spinach, stirring until just wilted, about 1-2 minutes.
Pour in the eggs and let them sit a few seconds before gently folding with a spatula.
When the eggs are mostly set but still a little wet, sprinkle in the shredded cheddar and fold through off the heat, residual heat finishes melting it.
Split between 2 plates and serve immediately.

name: Beef & Bean Taco Bowl
instructions: Cook the rice per package directions.
Dice the onion and cook in a pan over medium heat until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the ground beef, break it apart, and brown fully, seasoning with salt, pepper, cumin, and chili powder to taste.
Drain and rinse the black beans, then stir them in and heat through for 2-3 minutes.
Divide the rice into 4 bowls, top with the beef-and-bean mixture, and finish with shredded cheddar.
notes: Freezes well; good candidate for a bigger batch.

name: Pasta Marinara with Black Beans
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta per package directions until al dente, then drain.
While the pasta cooks, drain and rinse the black beans.
Warm the olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat, add the marinara sauce and black beans, and simmer 5-8 minutes to heat through and let the flavors combine.
Toss the drained pasta with the sauce and beans, then divide into 4 portions.
notes: Vegan as written; beans stand in for the usual meat for protein per dollar.

name: Greek Yogurt Protein Bowl
instructions: Split the Greek yogurt between 2 bowls.
Slice the bananas and divide on top.
Warm the peanut butter for 10-15 seconds if it's stiff, then drizzle over each bowl.
Serve immediately, or refrigerate covered for up to a day.
notes: No cook time, good for a day with zero free time.
